title: feat(driver-sql): SQL Server as a federation-only dialect
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi7ghxnTm51PSygb4ygX2wUJ)_

Fixes #31327

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: generated only — `skills/objectstack-data/references/_index.md` gains the `driver/mssql.zod.ts` row (`gen:skill-refs`); no hand-written skill text changes.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：外部数据源新增 SQL Server（`driver: 'mssql'`，别名 `sqlserver` / `tedious`），只做联邦：能读写已有的 SQL Server 表，Studio 能列出 `dbo.Orders` 这类表并导入为对象；平台永不在 SQL Server 上建表或改表，managed 数据源声明它会在解析时被拒。
- **为什么改**：企业客户的业务数据大量在 SQL Server（ERP、财务库）。没有这个方言之前，driver-sql 把它当 `unknown`，文本匹配在 SQL Server 默认不区分大小写的排序规则下答错，分页语法也不合法。
- **风险与回滚**：新增驱动行与新方言分支，其余驱动行为不变（boot 主机的驱动选择类型把联邦专用 id 排除在外，穷举仍然成立）。另改了一个检查脚本：`check-driver-conformance` 把联邦套件单列报告，不计入托管矩阵覆盖。回滚即整体 revert。
- **先看**：① `packages/spec/src/data/driver/config-registry.zod.ts`（federationOnly 列与选择面类型）② `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-predicate-emitters.ts` 的 mssql 文本匹配分支（BIN2 + TRANSLATE）③ `scripts/check-driver-conformance.mjs` 的 federation 立场（新语义）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/sql-driver-mssql-dialect.test.ts`，预期 15 条全过；有 SQL Server 时设 `OS_TEST_MSSQL_URL` 跑联邦一致性套件，预期 227/227。
- **需要你做的**：ADR-0015 §4.6 改动属受管面（Tier H），需要你批准；contract review owed（Fable 不可用，按默认档）。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec`**: the driver vocabulary gains `mssql` (aliases `sqlserver`, `tedious`) with `hasLocalDefault: false` and a new `federationOnly` column. `FEDERATION_ONLY_DRIVER_IDS` / `driverIsFederationOnly()` export the column; the types `FederationOnlyDriverId` and `DatabaseDriverSelectionId` keep federation-only ids off the boot-host selection face, so a host switching over it stays exhaustive. A `managed` datasource declaring `mssql` is refused at parse with a message naming the federation-only scope and the drivers that can own tables, derived from `DATABASE_DRIVER_SELECTION_IDS` rather than hand-listed. `MssqlConfigSchema` is the closed config (`host`, `port` 1433, `instanceName`, `database`, `username`, `ssl`); an inline password, a URL and `autoMigrate` are refused with the reason. The boot-host selection tables are built without federation-only rows, so the withdrawal holds by the column, not by the row's empty `aliases`. `type-compat` gains `SqlDialect` `'mssql'`, `DIALECT_ALIASES.mssql`, and one dialect-only pairing: on `mssql` a text column backs a `json`, `tags` or `multiselect` field as `'lossy'`, because SQL Server keeps JSON in `nvarchar(max)` and the driver stores those fields there. A self-signed server is documented as the datasource-level `ssl: { enabled: true, rejectUnauthorized: false }`: the block's `enabled` defaults to false, and a block without it turns encryption off. ADR-0015 §4.6 lists the dialect, and §5.1 gains the federation-only arm of Gate 1 (DDL refused in every mode, a `managed` datasource refused at parse).
- **`@objectstack/driver-sql`**: `dialectName` reads `'mssql'`. Paging is `OFFSET … FETCH` with an ORDER BY (the caller's keys, else the table's single-column primary key read from the catalog, else `(SELECT NULL)`), and `limit: 0` is `TOP (0)`. Identifiers are `[]`-quoted. Text predicates keep the #6518 contract on case-insensitive collations: case-exact through `Latin1_General_100_BIN2`, folded with `TRANSLATE`, `%` `_` `[` escaped with a bound ESCAPE. A `bit` aggregand is cast for SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX. Writes use `OUTPUT inserted.*` through a temp table, so a table with triggers accepts them. A `uniqueidentifier` reads back in the canonical lower-case form (tedious `lowerCaseGuids`, unless the host sets it), so the `uniqueidentifier` to `uuid` type-compat row holds: a GUID written as a string reads back as that string and filters by it in either case. Dates bind as ISO text against `nvarchar` columns. JSON text columns read back. Introspection lists user tables as `schema.table` with primary keys, foreign keys, single-column uniques and indexes. Managed DDL is refused (`SQL_DIALECT_EMISSION_UNSUPPORTED`), and `$contains` / `$empty` on a multi-value field is refused instead of approximated.
- **`@objectstack/service-datasource`**: the factory builds `SqlDriver` with the `tedious` connection (server, port, database, user, the bound secret as password, encrypt / trustServerCertificate / instanceName / CA from config and the datasource `ssl` block) and reports `@@VERSION`. `resolveSslOption` moves unchanged to the leaf module `datasource-ssl-option.ts`, so the connection pins load no driver; the liveness ledger's five citations of it are repointed. The Studio connection form does not offer `mssql`; it is declared in code (optional `tedious` peer, federation-only).
- **Docs**: `content/docs/data-modeling/external-datasources.mdx` gains "SQL Server (federation only)"; the reference page `references/data/driver-mssql.mdx` is generated.
- **`scripts/check-driver-conformance.mjs`**: a suite that names `MSSQL_FEDERATION_CELL` is a federation suite. It is listed on its own line under the dialect axis and is never counted as managed-matrix coverage, so it cannot discharge a managed DEBT entry (driver-sql's `UNIQUE_NULL_DISTINCT` debt stays) or trip MATRIXED. `FEDERATION_CELL_SYMBOLS` is the list a further federation-only dialect appends to. Self-test gains three assertions.

## Tests

- `sql-driver-mssql-dialect.test.ts`: 15 offline pins, one per emitter arm (OUTPUT, emission refusal, the lower-case GUID connection option, each text operator, JSON-array refusals, paging, aggregands, qualified-name split). Runs everywhere, no server.
- `sql-driver-mssql-federation-conformance.test.ts`: the shared case-sets FILTER_LOGIC, FILTER_TEXT, FILTER_COMPARAND_TYPE, TEMPORAL, TEMPORAL_TIME, PAGINATION (incl. unordered and zero-limit), AGGREGATION, VALUE_ROUNDTRIP, UNIQUE_NULL_DISTINCT (filtered unique indexes), READABLE_IDS, plus a write block on a table with a trigger and a default, and a `uniqueidentifier` block (create answers the GUIDs as written; equality and `$in` match in either case; update by a GUID id lands); CROSS_FIELD is asserted as the federated-object refusal. Built with raw DDL plus `registerExternalObject` in a per-file schema.
- The live cell is opt-in: `OS_TEST_MSSQL_URL` provisions it, `OS_EXPECT_MSSQL_FEDERATION=1` makes an unprovisioned run fail. No CI job hosts SQL Server, so in CI it is a declared skip, and the live-dialect coverage report prints `live sql server (federation) NOT RUN`.
- `mssql-connection.test.ts` (service-datasource, 6 tests, two of them the datasource `ssl` block through the spec parse, `resolveSslOption` and `buildMssqlConnection`: `enabled: true` keeps `encrypt` on with `trustServerCertificate`, and a block without it is `encrypt: false`), a table-wide pin that no spelling of a federation-only row resolves on the selection face, the CLI driver-vocabulary parity pin (a federation-only driver resolves its contract, and `os start` refuses it in dev and prod even with a URL), the credential-slot pin and the analytics echo-bucket roster gain `mssql`.
- Tests that used `mssql` as the stand-in for an unmodelled dialect now use `UnmodelledKnexClient` (`unmodelled-knex-client.testkit.ts`).

## Acceptance notes

Known gaps, stated so nobody reads them as covered:

- Column-map handling on `update()` / `delete()` / `bulkDelete()` / `aggregate()` / `distinct()` landed on main with #31349 and is merged in here; this PR does not touch those paths.
- A table whose key is an IDENTITY column cannot be written through the platform (the insert names the key); keep such a datasource read-only.
- JSON-array membership (`$contains` on a multi-value field) and `$empty` on one are refused on mssql.
- Date buckets run in memory: the dialect advertises no native date granularity.
- service-analytics' native-SQL face still uses plain LIKE for mssql: #31394.
- A table with no single-column primary key pages in an order SQL Server does not guarantee; the driver warns.
- Cross-field `$field` comparisons are refused on federated objects on every dialect (existing behaviour).
- SQL Server 2017 is the floor (`TRANSLATE`).
- Substring operators on a `uniqueidentifier` column compare against SQL Server's own upper-case text form of the GUID; filter a GUID by equality (documented in the SQL Server section): #31395.
- The Studio connection form does not offer `mssql` yet: #31389 tracks offering it there as federation-only.
- The spec API surface widens by 8 exports (listed in `api-surface/data.json`).

## Verification

Head `194571ae2f`, merged with `origin/main` at `7189fb2a`. The contract review of `dfc8a224c5` is answered on this head: the must-fix (the `ssl` prescription) and should-fixes 1 to 4; the naming reconcile with #31351 follows in the merge after it lands.

<details><summary>Live SQL Server (local container, SQL Server 2022 image, TZ=America/New_York)</summary>

`OS_TEST_MSSQL_URL=... OS_EXPECT_MSSQL_FEDERATION=1 vitest run sql-driver-mssql-federation-conformance.test.ts sql-driver-mssql-dialect.test.ts`: 2 files, 227 passed on `dfc8a224c5`. Coverage reporter: `live sql server (federation) RAN`. This head changes no driver-sql source.

</details>

<details><summary>Package suites and typechecks</summary>

- `@objectstack/driver-sql` full suite: 241 files passed, 13 skipped; 3899 tests passed, 219 skipped (no live server env). `tsc --noEmit` clean.
- `@objectstack/spec` full suite: 821 files, 25977 passed, 1 todo (before the refusal-message change; the config-registry and datasource files re-run after it, 556 passed). `check:test-typecheck` OK. `check:generated` OK after a spec build.
- `@objectstack/service-datasource` full suite on this head: 73 files, 1285 passed. `tsc --noEmit` clean.
- `@objectstack/spec` `src/data` on this head: 163 files, 6051 passed. `check:liveness` and `check:test-typecheck` OK.
- `@objectstack/service-analytics` echo-bucket enumeration: 236 passed.
- `@objectstack/cli` driver-vocabulary parity: 131 passed; database-driver flag derivation: 11 passed. `tsc --noEmit` clean.
- `@objectstack/runtime` dev-auto-migrate: 7 passed. `tsc --noEmit` clean.
- ESLint (`--no-inline-config`) over every changed `.ts`/`.mjs` file: clean.

</details>

<details><summary>dispatch-gates</summary>

On `f8388ce29e`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` 146 derived families, 146 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, every exit code 0; the 60 artifact-roster and wide-population families also run, all 0 except the four that need the workflow's PR context (closing-target, Part-of, single-claim paths, governed queue guard), which CI ran green. CI then found `check:facade-delegation-only` (a roster family) and the dropped-refinements header count; both fixed here. The sweep on `194571ae2f` is posted as a separate comment.

</details>

Not run here: SQL Server in CI (no job provisions it; the cell is a declared skip there). Full dogfood is not owed (Clause-② is a widening and the title carries no `!`).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
